About Leapfrog

Leapfrog is on a mission to be a role model technology company. Since 2010, we have relentlessly worked on crafting better digital products with our team of superior engineers. We’re a full-stack company specializing in SaaS products and have served over 100 clients with our mastery of emerging technologies.

We’re thinkers and doers, creatives and coders, makers and builders— but most importantly, we are trusted partners with world-class engineers. Hundreds of companies in Boston, Seattle, Silicon Valley, and San Francisco choose us to gain speed, agility, quality, and stability, giving them an edge over their competitors.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and smooth operation of our infrastructure. This role requires deep technical expertise in cloud computing, automation, and infrastructure management, along with a proactive mindset to drive operational excellence and mentor junior engineers. You will be responsible for maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure production environments, with a strong focus on AWS cloud infrastructure. You'll also lead infrastructure automation, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure our systems run efficiently and securely.

Job Description

  • Ensure smooth operation, accounting, and reliability of the overall infrastructure.

  • Deploy, monitor, and maintain production environments and cloud-native solutions.

  • Design, plan, and manage highly available and secure AWS cloud infrastructure.

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities in deployment, infrastructure provisioning, and system management.

  • Oversee infrastructure monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization using industry best practices.

  • Design, configure, and monitor secure and scalable network infrastructure.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in Linux-based remote servers and local workstations (Linux & Windows).

  • Perform in-depth analysis of security incidents and anomalies using logs, alerts, and monitoring tools.

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and resource scaling for optimal efficiency.

  • Maintain and manage application, web, and database servers including Apache, Nginx, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.

  • Support the deployment, operation, monitoring, and scaling of AI/Generative AI workloads, and identify opportunities to leverage AI for infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, observability, and engineering productivity.

  • Mentor junior DevOps engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.

  • Drive adoption of organizational processes, DevOps standards, and best practices.

  • Contribute to technical and architectural decisions related to cloud infrastructure, automation, security, reliability, and AI-enabled platforms.

  • Stay up to date with evolving technologies and trends in cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, Generative AI, and infrastructure engineering.

  • AWS Certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Associate / Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) are a strong plus.

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform.

  • Strong knowledge of containerization using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Travis CI, Jenkins, etc.

  • Competent in configuring and managing databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.

  • Experience managing application and web servers such as Apache and Nginx.

  • Solid Linux administration skills (Ubuntu, CentOS, Amazon Linux), including installation, package management, user and process control, and system monitoring.

  • Proficient in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Go, or similar languages.

  • Understanding of networking concepts including TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, routing protocols, load balancing, HTTP/HTTPS, and network security.

  • Strong grasp of security principles and familiarity with web-based security tools and methodologies.

  • Experience with source control systems such as Git.

  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent

  • Working knowledge of Generative AI concepts and architectures, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, AI agents, inference, and model serving.

  • Ability to deploy, operate, monitor, and scale AI/GenAI workloads using cloud-native technologies, with an understanding of compute/GPU requirements, latency, reliability, observability, and cost optimization.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development and DevOps tools to improve engineering productivity, automation, troubleshooting, incident analysis, documentation, and infrastructure management.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills; able to present ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong mentorship mindset with the ability to guide junior engineers and foster team growth.

  • Self-driven and highly motivated individual capable of working independently and taking ownership of initiatives.

About the role

We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data warehouses that power analytics, AI, and business applications. The ideal candidate has strong software engineering and database fundamentals, cloud experience, and expertise in data modeling, orchestration, and automation, with a passion for delivering reliable, secure, and high-quality data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize data models, database schemas, and storage solutions to support high-performance data processing.

  • Manage relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring performance, scalability, security, and data integrity.

  • Develop SQL objects including stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and optimized queries for efficient data processing.

  • Design and maintain OLTP and OLAP data systems, including dimensional modelling and data warehouse architectures.

  • Implement data validation, monitoring, and quality assurance processes to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

  • Develop and integrate REST APIs for data ingestion, distribution, and retrieval.

  • Automate workflows and orchestrate complex data pipelines using Apache Airflow and other ETL automation tools.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data solutions.

  • Contribute to data governance, security, documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and Git-based collaborative development workflows.

  • Continuously evaluate and adopt modern technologies, cloud services, and AI-powered development practices.

About the Role

As a Staff Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the growth, performance, wellbeing, and engagement of our engineering teams. You will be responsible for managing a group of engineers, enabling their career development, supporting their project and staffing needs, and ensuring effective execution of department strategic initiatives.

You will work closely with Senior Managers, Engineering Managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate organizational priorities into effective day-to-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, creating clarity, solving operational challenges, and helping engineers grow. You will have ownership of initiatives within your scope and will be expected to identify practical improvements based on your experience and execution learnings.

Key Responsibilities

  • People Management & Employee Experience

  • Lead the overall growth, engagement, wellbeing, appraisal and performance management of engineers.

  • Build strong relationships through regular one on one check-ins, feedback, career conversations, and timely support.

  • Address employee concerns, performance challenges, and conflicts constructively and proactively.

Career Development & Growth

  • Understand engineers' skills, aspirations, and development needs and translate them into meaningful growth plans.

  • Identify skill gaps and appropriate development, mentoring, and upskilling opportunities.

  • Support engineers through career progression, performance reviews, and continuous development.

  • Staff Management Initiatives & Operational Excellence

  • Own and deliver assigned strategic initiatives within defined scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

  • Identify execution gaps and recommend practical improvements to strengthen operational effectiveness.

Staffing & Workforce Planning

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Operations to support hiring, onboarding, staffing, and project alignment.

  • Support effective project alignment by understanding team capabilities, availability, and business needs.

  • Identify staffing risks and coordinate with stakeholders to address capacity and resource requirements.

Organizational Alignment

  • Execute departmental priorities and OKRs in collaboration with Senior Staff Managers and Engineering Managers.

  • Provide practical insights and recommendations based on team and operational needs.

  • Collaborate across functions to ensure consistent execution of Staff Management practices.

About Leapfrog

Leapfrog is on a mission to be a role model technology company. Since 2010, we have relentlessly worked on crafting better digital products with our team of superior engineers. We’re a full-stack company specializing in SaaS products and have served over 100 clients with our mastery of emerging technologies.

We’re thinkers and doers, creatives and coders, makers and builders — but most importantly, we are trusted partners with world-class engineers. Hundreds of companies in Boston, Seattle, Silicon Valley, and San Francisco choose us to gain speed, agility, quality, and stability, giving them an edge over their competitors.

About the Role

We are looking for a Solution Architect who operates at the intersection of business and technology. In this role, you will lead client conversations from discovery through delivery — developing a deep understanding of business goals and end-customer needs, and shaping solutions that are technically sound, commercially viable, and built to scale. You will own architecture decisions across large-scale engagements, guide cross-functional teams through the full software development lifecycle, and champion modern, AI-powered engineering practices across projects.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Discovery

  • Lead client conversations through the design and discovery phases of new and existing projects, acting as a trusted technical advisor.

  • Build a strong understanding of each client’s business domain, objectives, and end-customer needs, and shape solutions accordingly.

  • Gather and analyze business requirements, and plan the product roadmap in collaboration with the project manager and the client.

  • Ideate and evaluate solution options with stakeholders, balancing business value with technical feasibility.

  • Architecture & Solution Design

  • Lead and oversee solution analysis, architecture design, and technical documentation across engagements.

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Lead and oversee solution analysis, architecture design, and technical documentation across engagements.

  • Design architectures grounded in the AWS Well-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.

  • Ensure solutions meet scalability, availability, and performance objectives from the outset.

Estimation & Delivery Planning

  • Right-size engagements with credible estimates for timelines, team size and composition, and cost.

  • Decide the right balance of project deliverables based on resources, cost, effort, and time.

  • Lead the end-to-end software development lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, deployment, and handover.

  • Embed AI-powered SDLC practices and tooling to raise delivery velocity and engineering quality.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve project and organizational goals.

  • Comply with all professional, departmental, and company best practices.

  • Regularly inspect and improve project delivery and engineering processes.

  • 10+ years of experience in the software industry, with demonstrated experience architecting large-scale solutions.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional preferred).

  • Strong command of the Cloud Well-Architected Framework and a track record of applying it in real-world engagements.

  • Proven ability to estimate and right-size engagements — timelines, team sizing, cost analysis, and capacity planning.

  • Demonstrable experience with application scalability, availability, and performance.

  • Experience leading the end-to-end SDLC, with working knowledge of AI-powered SDLC practices and tools.

  • Experience working with Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic orchestration, and applying them in real-world applications.

  3. Be considered for roles that match your skills and experience.

  4. Stay connected with our Talent Acquisition team.

  5. Receive updates about relevant career opportunities.

How it works:

  1. CV Submission: Complete the form, upload your CV, and share your areas of interest and expertise.

  2. Profile Collection: Your profile will be securely stored in our talent database for consideration against current and future openings.

  3. Match-Making: Our Talent Acquisition team reviews profiles and matches them with relevant opportunities as hiring needs arise.
